label: YACHT TENDER
authoring: Written by the rig: YachtTenderIso.byId('yacht_tender').walk(), every number its own (mm), stamped with the rig's LF sha256 and fitted to character rig 10.3 (qa.character) by tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs. Regenerate with node tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs --write; never edit by hand.
frame: metres; +x starboard, +y bow, +z up; origin amidships, keel bottom, centreline; polygons counter-clockwise seen from above

walk.rule: A step is legal when the target point is inside an area polygon and outside its holes, and |area z - player z| < stepTol. Ramps interpolate z along their axis (x or y) between a0 and a1, and hold z0 / z1 beyond them. cut = the cutaway key while standing there; cutHi / cutLo replace it above / below zMid (stairs and ladders). Polygons are player-centre: already inset by radius, so the reader never insets them again.

areas.note: aft of the leaning post to the transom cap; the post’s stern light (-0.86) is its forward edge

the standing room at the console: 0.476 m between the leaning post and the wheel’s rim, a 0.016 m strip at the walker’s radius. It does not join the cockpit (beside_post): the helm is taken from the cockpit (interact helm)
the sole between the console and the bow seat: 0.48 m, a 0.02 m strip at the walker’s radius. It does not join the helm or the cockpit (beside_console)

interact.label: Helm
interact.note: a standing console: the pilot stands between it and the leaning post, whose cushion is the perch (seat). Taken from the cockpit, behind the post.

interact.label: Outboard
interact.note: tilt 0 down … 1 up 66° about the transom bracket, worked over the transom cap

cleats.note: the bow lifting eye: the painter
a stern lifting eye, also the stern line’s
a stern lifting eye, also the stern line’s

_excluded.reason: the sole beside the leaning post: 0.16 m between the post (0.8 m wide) and the sole’s edge, narrower than the walker’s 0.46 m. The cockpit and the helm do not join at the walker’s radius.

the sole beside the console: 0.2 m between the console (0.72 m wide) and the sole’s edge, 0.149 m beside its grab rails, narrower than the walker’s 0.46 m. The bow does not join the helm or the cockpit at the walker’s radius.
the sole forward of the bow seat’s box: 0.07 m deep fore and aft, 0.15-0.1 m wide: no centre point fits the walker.

the tubes: 0.52 m round, their tops 0.4 m over the sole and 0.52 m over the water. Sat on and stepped over to board (board / boardDown), not walked. She has no ladder: a swimmer comes aboard over them (ladderOn).
the transom cap: 0.13 m deep fore and aft and 0.24 m over the sole, a ledge, not a floor. The outboard is worked from the cockpit (interact outboard).
the leaning post: its cushion, 0.63 m over the sole, is the helm’s perch (anchors.helm), not a standing surface. Perching waits on sit.
the bow seat and its forward box, the cushion 0.44 m over the sole: a seat. Sitting waits on sit.
an open boat: no side deck. The tubes are sat on and stepped over, not walked (tubes); her lines are made fast to the lifting eyes (cleats).

fitCheck.note: an open boat: no room faces to check

character.method: every frame of each clip for all thirty builds (evalClip + pinsOf), world opts from the walk; hands vs the wheel rim, the lying body vs the berth outline and deckhead, crowns vs headroom, shoulders (2 x collision radius) vs clear widths

fixtures.note: the opts clamp: the clip poses its wheel up to 0.14 m from the hub

Why not: helm_idle takes no wheel opts, so each build holds its hands where its own arms put them: 0.784 to 1.231 m over the floor and 0.312 to 0.482 m ahead of its feet. One wheel is within 0.02 m of a few of those grips at most. This wheel is set for drive (seated, 30 of 30), which takes it no higher than 0.95 m over the floor (this hub: 0.68 m), and its seat is 0.61 m behind the hub, so a figure standing at the reach helm_idle holds would stand in the seat. At the rig’s pilot spot (0.29 m behind the hub) the hands’ midpoint misses the hub by up to 0.583 m. Standing waits on helm_idle taking wheelZ / wheelY (as drive does) and a helm with standing room in front of its seat.

fixtures.what: walk every area (3 of them) at the walker’s radius 0.23 m
fixtures.note: each outline is inset by the walker’s radius, the widest 10.3 build’s collision radius or more: every build’s shoulders fit wherever the walker goes. Headroom is the stand fixtures’; steps are the step fixtures’.

fixtures.what: come aboard from the water (onto tubes, 0.52 m above the waterline; no ladder)
fixtures.note: no ladder on this hull: a swimmer cannot climb back aboard (see _excluded tubes)
10.3 has no sit clip: drive is its only seated clip, and its hands hold a wheel
